about.heading: About
paragraphs: Alongside studying computer science at Kwansei Gakuin University, I've thrown myself into choral music as a member of the Kwansei Gakuin Glee Club.

As an engineer, I design and build web applications, and own business systems end-to-end — from development through ongoing maintenance. As a choral singer, I've served as a part leader and head of the club's IT/systems department, supporting both performance and organizational operations.

Engineering is built by stacking logic; ensemble singing is built by layering voices. Two crafts that rarely meet on paper — but to me they're the same continuous act: bringing individual strengths together into a single, coherent whole.
